subject: Post-demo handover: onboarding session & API/Console walkthrough
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cobaltfin.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@cobaltfin.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-demo: scheduling onboarding walkthrough

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the team at Cobalt Financial found the performance and observability bits really compelling. We'd like to move to an onboarding session to get our engineers and SREs up to speed on the Console and API key flows (and validate our environment access).

Can we book a 60–75 minute session next week that covers:
- Console walkthrough (routing, rollout controls, observability)
- API key provisioning & scoped keys
- Quick API call walkthrough (auth, token rotation)
- Preflight checks for our environment (VPC rules / IP allowlist)

Proposed windows (all ET):
1) Wed Jul 26, 10:00–11:15
2) Thu Jul 27, 14:00–15:15
3) Fri Jul 28, 09:30–10:45

Priya (cc) will be coordinating on our side. If you can send a draft agenda and any prep checklist we should complete beforehand, that would help us avoid access delays.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Engineering | Cobalt Financial
liam.oconnor@cobaltfin.com

--
Attachment: requested-demo-notes.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cobaltfin.com>, Priya Singh <priya@cobaltfin.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: scheduling onboarding walkthrough

Hi Liam — great to hear. Happy to run the session. Sofia (cc) will lead the console portion and I’ll cover API provisioning and runbook handoff.

We can do Wed 26 or Fri 28; Thu 27 is a bit tight for our EU-heavy SRE lead but still possible. To avoid back-and-forth, here are three slots with tester/backup coverage:
- Wed Jul 26, 10:00–11:15 ET (Sofia lead)
- Fri Jul 28, 09:30–10:45 ET (Sofia + me)
- Fri Jul 28, 13:00–14:15 ET (backup, Ben can cover the API demo)

I've attached a draft agenda and an environment access checklist — please run the checklist with your infra team before the session. If you expect more than 6 attendees or want an extended Q&A, let me know and we'll make it 90 minutes.

Attachments: onboarding_agenda_v0.3.pdf, env-access-checklist.xlsx

Next steps:
1) Pick the preferred slot and confirm attendee list (esp. any SSO/Network owners).
2) Share a single point of contact for granting IP/port access (we need a contact who can approve allowlist entries).
3) We will send a calendar invite and a Meeting link once you confirm.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
O: +1 (415) 555-0183
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cobaltfin.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@cobaltfin.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 12:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: scheduling onboarding walkthrough

On Thu, Jul 19, 2028 at 11:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> I've attached a draft agenda and an environment access checklist — please run the checklist with your infra team before the session.

Thanks Vivek — we can do Fri Jul 28, 09:30–10:45 ET (slot 2). One quick ask: can we start at 09:15 instead? Several stakeholders have a conflicting leadership sync at 10:45 and an extra 15 minutes would let us finish the runbook handoff cleanly.

Attendees (so far):
- Liam O'Connor (Platform)
- Priya Singh (Program manager)
- Diego Marquez (SRE)
- Amira Khan (Security)

Diego will be the access approver for IP allowlist changes during the session — his email is diego.marquez@cobaltfin.com. Can you add him to the invite?

Also, two quick prep Qs:
1) For API keys, will you demonstrate scoped keys + rotation?
2) For Console, can Sofia show the rollout canary UI and the cost-by-route dashboard?

If you confirm the 09:15 start and add Diego, we'll lock it in.

Cheers,
Liam

--
Attachment: none
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: scheduling onboarding walkthrough

Thanks Liam — confirmed for Fri Jul 28, 09:15–10:45 ET and Diego added. I've created the calendar invite and included the Meet link below. Please accept when you get it.

Google Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
Meet link: https://meet.google.com/xyz-meet
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-4921

Quick notes for the session:
- We will demonstrate scoped API keys and rotation best practices (Vivek) and a live token rotate via the API (Ben).
- Sofia will cover canary rollout and the cost-by-route dashboard with a short walkthrough and a troubleshooting checklist.
- Please have Diego available in case we need to test an allowlist change mid-call.

I've attached a meeting .ics and our lightweight runbook link. If you can drop credentials for a non-production tenant or a pre-provisioned test API key to diego.marquez@cobaltfin.com, that will speed up the hands-on portion.
